Guardrails & Boundaries

Steer what your agent covers and avoids, and how it handles sensitive topics.

Key topics to cover

Up to 5 topics the agent should cover, not things you want to find out — 'How pricing scales' beats 'Whether they can afford us'. Visitors never see this list and the agent won't announce or work through it; it only steers the follow-ups it offers toward what hasn't come up yet.

Add
Topics to avoid

Subjects the agent will politely decline or steer away from.

Add
Competitor handling

How the agent responds when visitors bring up competing products.

Don't mention
Avoid discussing competitors
Acknowledge & redirect
Acknowledge and steer back
Compare
Provide honest comparison
Custom instructions

Extra context that shapes tone, emphasis, or domain focus. The guardrails above take precedence — they can't be bypassed from here.

Make key topics specific — 'How pricing scales' beats 'pricing'.
